rejected.reason: Not a product catalog at all -- it is the corporate/CSR site for the Meridian Express kiosk-retail franchise network. Only 1 JSON-LD block on the homepage and it is Yoast's generic WebPage/Organization schema, not Product data. Our own tooling's 'reverse-engineerable-embedded' verdict appears to be a false positive (it likely matched on the mere presence of an ld+json tag without checking its @type). No /products.json, no WooCommerce route (confirmed via /wp-json/ route list -- no wc/store namespace present), no offer/price data anywhere on the page.

Confirmed 'no-obvious-data-source'. Custom legacy PHP site (aktualitet.php?product=... weekly-offer pages). Zero ld+json blocks anywhere. /products.json and /wp-json/wc/store/products both 404. The 'offer' pages are static promotional flyer IMAGES (images/aktualitet1.png etc.) with no machine-readable product text or price at all.
HTTP 403 Forbidden on every request (root and www, with full browser headers) -- WAF/bot-blocking prevents any programmatic access.
HTTP 500 Internal Server Error on repeated attempts (root and www); site is not serving working pages at all right now.
DNS resolution failure ('Could not resolve host') -- domain does not currently resolve.

Real, live nopCommerce marketplace (GjirafaMall KS) with food categories including /biskota-ushqime, but product data is rendered server-side as plain HTML grid only -- the only JSON-LD present is Organization/CollectionPage/FAQPage schema, no Product schema, no products.json, no WooCommerce REST route. Sampled the biscuits category page directly: 6 products shown (Lotus Biscoff, various Gambini biscuit packs), no Sempre found, no brand/origin field visible in the markup. Would require full HTML scraping, not a JSON API, so it fails the 'usable source' bar as defined; also a general marketplace mixing local and heavily imported goods with no way to filter by origin.
